label: functional human arrays in sheep
takeaway: Works on the real device: lower impedance and less inflammation on a working implant.

label: less protein, cell and bacterial adhesion and friction, published bench studies
takeaway: Nothing sticks: the hydration shell turns away protein, cells and bacteria before scar or biofilm can start.
source: Leigh 2017, Leigh 2019, Jensen 2021, Shen 2021, Horne 2023, Bennion 2021, Peel 2024, Barrera 2026 (see W05; median of the plotted bars is about 94 percent, range about 53 to 99)
